meaning: Declared before subpixel measurements. Replace peak/parabolic center with the first moment of a single positive-deficit lobe; distinguish measured initialization from subsequent physical turn. Offline only, same frozen identities and all controls; no product endpoint or rendering.

Measure five fixed-axis profiles spanning nominal2native pixels around the existing body seed, reject any failure or unconfirmed dense link, fit TLS with residual<=.25native. Align to that observed bootstrap axis; record initial-prior discrepancy separately, never call it physical curvature. Refine only the offline body seed within .5native; old product tip stays fixed.
